news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.92 (vs ₹0.18 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.92 (up from ₹0.18 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹31.3m (down 73% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.02m (up 296% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 13% (up from 0.9% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 115 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.6% average weekly change). Earnings have declined by 19% per year over the past 5 years. Market cap is less than US$10m
